# VYB-SEO

> Open-source AI SEO agent for websites whose blog is Markdown/MDX in a GitHub repo. Deployed to Vercel with the user's own Anthropic or OpenAI key. Daily, it audits posts, fixes mechanical issues, researches keywords (Google Autocomplete + Search Console), refreshes pages near page one, rewrites low-CTR titles, writes new articles behind a quality gate, adds internal links, and opens a pull request. Settings live in `.seo-agent/` in the user's website repo.

## Setting it up for a user

- [SETUP.md](https://github.com/pulipakaharshith-alt/VYB-SEO/blob/main/SETUP.md): step-by-step guide for AI agents: inspect the website repo, write `.seo-agent/config.json` and `.seo-agent/brand.md`, collect credentials, deploy to Vercel, verify.
- [SAFETY.md](https://github.com/pulipakaharshith-alt/VYB-SEO/blob/main/SAFETY.md): risks and guard rails; read before the first run.
- Claude subscription (no API key): Claude Code plugin `vyb-seo` from marketplace `pulipakaharshith-alt/VYB-SEO` (`/vyb-seo:seo run`), plus a scheduled GitHub Action template at templates/github-action/seo-agent.yml. See SETUP.md step 9.
- [.env.example](https://github.com/pulipakaharshith-alt/VYB-SEO/blob/main/.env.example): every environment variable.
- [README.md](https://github.com/pulipakaharshith-alt/VYB-SEO/blob/main/README.md): what it does, cost, limits.

## Requirements

- Blog posts are `.md`/`.mdx` files with YAML frontmatter, one file per post, directly in one folder of a GitHub repo.
- A fine-grained GitHub token for that repo (Contents + Pull requests: read & write).
- Either an Anthropic or OpenAI API key plus a Vercel account (Vercel app), or a Claude Pro/Max/Team/Enterprise plan (Claude Code plugin).

## Not supported yet

CMS-hosted blogs (WordPress, Webflow, Ghost), nested post folders, TOML frontmatter, date-prefixed file names (Jekyll `_posts`).
